summary: The RuntimeTool behavior, efficiency, and stability claims are all exercised by concrete, falsifiable gates. The shared production configure_builder handler is tested through Tauri IPC and a real PTY with only the agent executable substituted; Jet independently pins frontend IPC argument mapping before evidence is accepted; and twelve lifecycle cycles verify process reaping, transcript bounds, recovery, folder preservation, and all context renderers after every cycle. Independent getrusage and elapsed-time measurements enforce the efficiency limits, and the unfiltered seven-test gate cannot pass an empty implementation.
